findings.description: The annotation for `PreparedRequest.headers` was changed to an immutable `Mapping[str, object]`. The runtime object is a mutable `CaseInsensitiveDict`, and the title says to move `Request.headers` back to Mapping, not `PreparedRequest.headers`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: user or hook code does `prepared.headers['X'] = ...`, which is the documented way to modify a PreparedRequest, or calls `.update()`/`.pop()`. Mechanism: the Mapping annotation has no `__setitem__`, so type checkers report errors on these valid operations. Impact: false type errors in user code, and the type no longer matches the real behavior. The `object` value type also loses the str/bytes guarantee on prepared headers.
